creator.notes: Synthetic long-tail creator with no dedicated profile. Exercises the unanimous path end to end: claims that all three lenses accept, a 2-of-3 accept that must NOT pass, a single reject that blocks acceptance, a naming mapping every lens abstained on, a newly discovered source approved 3-of-3, and a newly discovered source approved by only 2 of 3 that must be refused. Rich enough that the promotion criteria are all met.

sources.title: Introducing Scribe 2
sources.text: Scribe 2 handles 64,000 tokens of context. It is the second model we have shipped under the Scribe name.

review.rationale: The announcement states the number outright.

claims.quote: It is the second model we have shipped under the Scribe name

provenance.rationale: The page uses 'the Scribe name' in passing. Whether that is a family label or a brand is not something this quote settles.

consistency.rationale: There is no reviewed terminology for this creator, so there is nothing to check the proposed family label against.

editorial.rationale: Naming a family here would fix a mapping the source never states. Better left open.

sources.title: Scribe 2 documentation
sources.text: Scribe 2 is the current generally available model. It returns up to 8,192 tokens per response. Scribe 2 is a long-form drafting model. Scribe 2 is intended for drafting and editing prose.

claims.quote: Scribe 2 is the current generally available model
It returns up to 8,192 tokens per response
Scribe 2 is a long-form drafting model

consistency.rationale: Nothing else in the run contradicts it.

editorial.rationale: A one-line marketing description from an unreviewed creator is not something I can judge as a dataset summary.

claims.quote: Scribe 2 is intended for drafting and editing prose

provenance.rationale: The quote states the intended use.

consistency.rationale: Consistent with the rest of the documentation.

editorial.rationale: This restates the product pitch rather than an intended-use statement, and for an unreviewed creator that distinction matters.

source_review.rationale: Published by the creator itself on its documentation host and cited as the model card for this release.

review.rationale: Stated directly in the model card.

sources.title: What we hear about Scribe 3
sources.text: Scribe 3 is said to accept 128,000 tokens of context.

provenance.rationale: The page exists and says what is quoted.

consistency.rationale: Nothing else in the run contradicts it.

editorial.rationale: Third-party speculation about an unannounced release, for a creator nobody has reviewed. Not a source this proposal should rest on.

claims.quote: Scribe 3 is said to accept 128,000 tokens of context

review.rationale: The quote supports the value, whatever the source is worth.
